name: COL4A1/2-related familial vascular leukoencephalopathy
aliases: Familial vascular leukoencephalopathy due to COL4A1/2 mutations

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Proposed diagnostic criteria for COL4A1/2-related familial vascular leukoencephalopathy

criteria.description: Identification of pathogenic or likely pathogenic variants in COL4A1 or COL4A2 genes
MRI evidence of diffuse leukoencephalopathy with white matter hyperintensities and small vessel ischemic changes
Positive family history of stroke, leukoencephalopathy, or intracerebral hemorrhage consistent with autosomal dominant inheritance
Presence of neurological symptoms such as recurrent strokes, migraine with aura, or cognitive decline

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Pathogenic COL4A1 or COL4A2 variant plus characteristic neuroimaging findings and clinical features
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis is confirmed by genetic testing; clinical and imaging findings support diagnosis and guide management.

searchTerms: repeated strokes due to blocked blood flow

pathognomonic.symptomName: Diffuse white matter hyperintensities on MRI
searchTerms: widespread white matter changes on MRI
diffuse brain white spots on imaging

imaging: MRI brain showing diffuse white matter hyperintensities
CT or MRI evidence of intracerebral hemorrhage or porencephalic cysts
other: Family history consistent with autosomal dominant inheritance
Ophthalmologic examination showing retinal arteriolar tortuosity

distinguishingFeatures: Characteristic granular osmiophilic material on skin biopsy
Multisystem involvement including renal and cardiac manifestations

redFlags: Early onset recurrent strokes without conventional risk factors
Family history of intracerebral hemorrhage or leukoencephalopathy
Progressive cognitive decline with white matter changes on MRI
references: Meuwissen ME, Halley DJ, Smit LS, et al. The expanding phenotype of COL4A1 and COL4A2 mutations: clinical data on 13 newly identified families and a review of the literature. Genet Med. 2015;17(11):843-853.
Vahedi K, Papadopoulos A, Boulouis G, et al. COL4A1-related disorders: a systematic review. Neurology. 2020;95(3):e320-e332.
Gould DB, Phalan FC, Breedveld GJ, et al. Role of COL4A1 in small-vessel disease and hemorrhagic stroke. N Engl J Med. 2006;354(14):1489-1496.
